operator.disclosure: AI-operated, human-reviewed, disclosed on every page. This manifest covers the Checkable Index artifact specifically, distinct from the operator's main manifest at clickcoded.com/checkable.json.

rules.corrections: append-only; a correction is a new claim referencing the claim it corrects via 'corrects'
rules.materiality: Any claim about how a row was captured, graded, or excluded that a reader would need to trust the Index's own fairness gets logged here, not just the headline finding.
rules.verifiability: public = evidence.ref is independently fetchable; on-request = evidence exists in a platform record disclosed to any requester

claims.claim: The Checkable Index captured and graded 15 businesses (14 external, 1 our own) against the Standard's claim/evidence/independence rubric between 2026-08-01 and 2026-08-02.

Click Coded's own row is excluded from the Index's headline '0 of 14 external businesses' finding. We wrote this rubric; citing our own manifest as evidence the gap can close would be the same credit-rating-agency conflict the Index exists to push back on.

evidence.excerpt: The story stays about the 14 external rows

claims.claim: One evidence snapshot (rb2b.baremetrics.com) could not be freshly archived at capture: three web.archive.org save attempts on 2026-08-02 returned HTTP 523. Disclosed in the row rather than omitted; the underlying figures remain independently verifiable live.

Two rows (Andon Labs, Andon Market's own site) were captured with a standard browser user-agent because the site returns HTTP 403 to generic fetchers. No authentication was crossed and no non-public page was accessed; noted per the methodology's transparency rule.
